column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“From the clan of Ram” is rendered “of the family of Ram,” and “more than God” as “before God.”
The Hebrew reads “condemned Job”; ancient scribal tradition says it once read “God.” NASB follows the Hebrew and adds “yet.”
“Waited Job in words” is rendered “waited to speak to Job.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Answered and said” is rendered “spoke out and said.” “I was anxious” is rendered “I was shy,” and “my knowledge” as “what I think.”
“Days” is rendered “age,” and “abundance of years” as “increased years.”
“Nevertheless” is rendered “But it is.”
“Many” is rendered “The abundant in years.”
“Knowledge” is rendered “what I think.”
“Searched for words” is rendered “pondered what to say.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Lest you should say” is rendered “Do not say,” and “drive about” as “rout.”
NASB supplies “his.” “Your words” is rendered “your arguments.”
“Moved away from them” is rendered “failed them.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Knowledge” is rendered “opinion.”
“The spirit of my belly” is rendered “The spirit within me.”
“Which is not opened” is rendered “unvented.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Lift up the face” is rendered “be partial.”
“Like a little” is rendered “soon”; NASB supplies “Else.”
